tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: phur pa yang gsang srog gi spu gri'i las byang nor bu'i phreng ba bzhugs so:

dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo: phur pa yang gsang spu gri yi: las byang rim pa 'di lta ste: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum: dang po sngon du 'gro la dgu: dang po tshogs gsag skyabs su 'gro: sems bskyed bgegs bskrad mtshams gcad cing: brda sgo dbye dang brda phyag 'tshal: dam bca' byin 'beb mchod byin rlabs: bshags pa dang ni bcu ru bstan: dang po tshogs gsag skyabs 'gro ni: dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi: sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags: 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang: sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung: sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: bdag gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir: bdag gis byang chub sems mchog bskyed: e ma ho: sems can ma lus kun mgron gnyer: byang chub spyod mchog mdzad bzhin spyad: 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas shog: gnyis pa 'jug sems bskyed pa ni: ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams: byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i: de bzhin bla med byang chub sems: dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi: byang chub sems ni bla na med: dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas: sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir: bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung: ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral: ma grol ba rnams grol bar bgyi: dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing: sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god: lan gsum: gsum pa bgegs gtor byin gyis brlabs te: bka' bsgo ba ni: hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs: mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di longs la: nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed: rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni: sdig can gang gis 'da' byed pa: stobs chen khro bo 'bar ba yis: klad pa tshal pa brgya ru khos: oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐: gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐: gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐: a na ya ho bha ga wān bid+ya rā dza ya hūm̐ phaṭa: bzhi pa mtshams gcad pa ni:

hūm̐: steng yang phur pa'i bla re la: phur pa'i thog chen char ltar 'beb: 'og kyang phur pa'i sa gzhi la: phur pa'i 'phro 'du me ltar 'bar: phyogs mtshams phur pas gtams pa la: phur pa'i tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: phur pa'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: gardza ha na da ha pa tsa bhan+dha hu lu tiṣ+ṭha tshin+dha bhin dha s+pho ṭa ya gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: lnga pa brda sgo dbye ba ni: hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i pho brang du: bdag cag dad pas 'jug par bgyi: tshad med bzhi ldan sgo ma bzhis: ye shes bzhi yi sgo phyes shig: oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭa: drug pa brda phyag 'tshal ba ni: ho: yang dag gsang ba'i pho brang du: lha dang slob dpon rdo rje'i mched: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: a ti pū ho pra tīts+tsha ho: bdun pa dam bca' ba ni: hūm̐: lhag pa'i lha khyod dgongs su gsol: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: rtag tu 'gro don mi skyo zhing: byang chub sems bskyed dam bca' 'o: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: brgyad pa byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐: srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang: dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir: gnyis med dag pa'i mkha' dbyings las: ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol: dbang chen rnams kyis dbang skur la: byin chen rnams kyis byin phob cig: mthu chen rnams kyis mthu stsol cig: rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang: kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: dhe ba bha sarba a dhiṣ+ṭhā na a be sha ya a ā: dgu pa mchod pa byin rlabs ni: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥthā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: rak+ta dz+wa la ni hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ kha ta li bh+rūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta ā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐: dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā keṃ ni ri ti:

ma hā pañtsa pu tsa ho: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bo dhi tsit+ta ga ṇa gu h+ya pū dzaḥho: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bcu pa bshags pa bya ba ni: ho: rdo rje gzhon nu sras 'khor ma lus dgongs: chos rnams mnyam yangs spros dang ye bral yang: ma rig dbang gis tha dad so sor bzung: don dam dbyer med ngang du mthol lo bshags: sa ma ya shud+dhe a: lan gsum mo: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni: ting 'dzin rnam gsum 'byung rim brtseg: gzhal yas lha bskyed spyan drangs shing: bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal dbang bskur zhing: gnyis med bstim dang phyi nang mchod: sman mchod gtor ma rak+ta dang: sbyor sgrol mchod dang bstod pa bsnyen: dngos grub blang dang bcu bzhi 'o: dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni: hūm̐: chos rnams stong zhing bdag med pa: rtag chad gnyis med de bzhin nyid: stong pa'i ngang las 'gro rnams la: snying rje chen po kun tu snang: kun snang*/ e: spros bral nam mkha'i klong yangs su: rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin/ hūm̐ las rim brtsegs yi ge bdun: 'byung ba rim brtseg/ e yaṃ ra suṃ keṃ raṃ bh+rūm̐: e las nam mkha' chos 'byung mthing: yaṃ las rlung dkyil rgya gram ljang: ra las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho zlum: sum ser nag las sha chen gyi: sa gzhi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa: keṃ las rus pa'i ri rab gzhi: raṃ las ye shes me dpung klong: bh+rūm̐ las 'od zer lnga 'phros pas: ye shes gzhal yas khang du gsal: e maṇ+ḍal: yaṃ karma rak+ṣa haṃ: ra rak+ta maṇ+ḍa la: suṃ tig na maṇ+ḍa la: keṃ ni ri ti maṇ+ḍa la: raṃ dz+wa la raṃ: bh+rūm̐ bhi shwa bi shud+dhe rat+na maṇ+ḍa la: e dzñā na maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐: gnyis pa gzhal yas lha bskyed ni: rab brjid dur khrod gzhal yas khang: phyi ni mchod rten rnam pa la: gru gsum mthing nag rin chen 'bar: gru chad bar khyams sgo khyud rdzogs: ngo mtshar ye shes me 'od gsal: rdo rje brag gtams sa gzhi la: lha chen phyogs skyong pho mo bsnol:

thabs shes nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan: ru tra kro ti ti ra baṃ: ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: a tsaṇ+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la: paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la: rgyu yi yi ge gdan la babs: 'od zer don gnyis hūm̐ la thim: s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: rdo rje rtse dgu lte bar hūm̐: tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku: lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid chen po kī la ya: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: rigs lngas dbu brgyan thugs srog gsal: dang po rtse dgu me dpung 'bar: bar gnyis rtse lnga kha ṭ+wāṃ ga: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu 'dril: rdo rje rin chen gshog par ldan: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la gsol: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma: g.yas pa gtso 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: g.yon pa chags pa'i dung dmar stob: yab yum zung 'jug bskyed pa yi: dpal chen yab kyi thugs ka yi: rin chen zur brgyad gzhal yas su: ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba/ sku mdog dkar: rdor dril rin chen rgyan ldan pa'i: thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sran gshag tsam/ steng: rdo rje'i nas 'bras tsam/ lte bar hūm̐ yungs 'bru tsam/ gis mtshan: tha mar snying po 'bru dgus bskor: srog gi sgo srung rta mgrin dmar: yum 'khyud gri thod chas brgyad ldan: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: sarba bhig nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: dpal chen yab yum thugs ka nas: chos 'byung phyi rol zla gam gsum: khams gsum dus gsum bsgral ba'i phyir: mthing nag bdun dang ljang nag bdun: dmar nag bdun gyi hūm̐ 'phros pas: khams gsum lus ngag yid gsum sbyangs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: sras mchog nyer gcig skur gyur te: kun kyang dbu gsum phyag drug pa: mthing nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal: phyag drug g.yas g.yon dang po ni: rdo rje rtse dgu me dpung bsnams:

bar pa rdo rje rtse lnga/ kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: mtha' gnyis phur pa 'dril zhing 'debs: dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan: sku smad lcags phur zur gsum pa: chu srin kha nas me 'od 'phro: dug gsum dgra bgegs snying gar btsugs: hūm̐: snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni: bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te: phung po rdo rjes gtams byas nas: rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom: slar yang gsang ba'i sbyor mtshams nas: phyogs skyong bcu yi gdan steng du: hūm̐ yig zung bcu 'phros pa las: khro bcu za gsod sgo ba'i tshogs: hūm̐: steng du hūm̐ kār khro bo'i sku: sngo skya dkar dang dmar ba'i zhal: dang pos rdo rjes dung khrag dkrugs: bar pas mda' gzhu 'geng zhing 'phen: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa 'dril: rdor gshog nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam gdengs: dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas kyis brgyan: lcags phur nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: rdo rje sgra 'byin sku la 'khril: g.yas pa be con g.yon dung khrag: yab yum sbyor ba'i byin rlabs las: phra men phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo: g.yas pa nyi zla g.yon phur 'dril: hūm̐: shar du rnam rgyal khro bo'i sku: dkar po sngo dang ser ljang zhal: dang pos rdo rjes dung khrag dkrugs: bar pas 'khor lo tri shul bsnams: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa 'dril: rdor gshog nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam gdengs: dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas kyis brgyan: lcags phur brgya byin gdan la bzhugs: rdo rje snyems ma sku la 'khril: g.yas pa ral gri g.yon dung khrag: yab yum sbyor ba'i byin rlabs las: phra men stag dang bya rgod mgo: rdo rje lcags kyu phur pa 'dril: hūm̐: shar lho dbyug sngon khro bo'i sku: sngo skya dkar dang dmar ba'i zhal: dang pos rdo rjes dung khrag dkrugs: bar gnyis me dbal dbyug tho bsnams: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa 'dril: rdor gshog nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam gdengs: dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas kyis brgyan:

lcags phur me lha'i gdan la bzhugs: rdo rje sder mo sku la 'khril: g.yas pa lcags kyu g.yon dung khrag: yab yum sbyor ba'i byin rlabs las: phra men g.yag dang bya rog mgo: dbyug tho me dbal phur pa 'debs: hūm̐: lho ru gshin rje khro bo'i sku: sngo skya ljang dang sngo ba'i zhal: dang pos rdo rjes dung khrag dkrug: bar pas dgra s+t+wa dbyug tho 'phyar: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa 'dril: rdor gshog nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam gdengs: dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas kyis brgyan: lcags phur gshin rje'i gdan la bzhugs: dur khrod bdag mo sku la 'khril: g.yas pa thod dbyug g.yon dung khrag: yab yum sbyor ba'i byin rlabs las: phra men sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo: dgra s+t+wa zhags pa phur pa 'debs: hūm̐: lho nub mi g.yo khro bo'i sku: ljang sngon sngo dang smug nag zhal: dang pos rdo rjes dung khrag dkrugs: bar pas ral gri zhags pa bsnams: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa 'dril: rdor gshog nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam gdengs: dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas kyis brgyan: lcags phur srin po'i gdan la bzhugs: rdo rje gtun khung yum dang 'khril: g.yas pa tho ba g.yon dung khrag: yab yum sbyor ba'i byin rlabs las: phra men gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo: ral gri lcags kyu phur pa 'debs: hūm̐: nub tu rta mgrin khro bo'i sku: dmar ser dkar dang sngo ba'i zhal: dang pos rdo rjes dung khrag dkrugs: bar pas spu gri zhags pa bsnams: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa 'dril: rdor gshog nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam gdengs: dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas kyis brgyan: lcags phur chu lha'i gdan la bzhugs: rdo rje gtum mo sku la 'khril: g.yas pa spu gri g.yon dung khrag: yab yum sbyor ba'i byin rlabs las: phra men byi la pu shud mgo: lcags kyu spu gri phur pa 'debs: hūm̐: nub byang 'dod rgyal khro bo'i sku: dmar skya ser dang ljang ba'i zhal: dang pos rdo rjes dung khrag dkrugs:

bar pas ba dan rnga yab bsnams: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa 'dril: rdor gshog nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam gdengs: dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas kyis brgyan: lcags phur rlung lha'i gdan la bzhugs: rdo rje mda' snyems sku la 'khril: g.yas pa tho ba g.yon dung khrag: yab yum sbyor ba'i byin rlabs las: phra men spyang ki khra yi mgo: ba dan rnga yab phur pa 'debs: hūm̐: byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ni: ljang nag ser dang dud kha'i zhal: dang pos rdo rjes dung khrag dkrugs: bar pas rgya gram dril bu bsnams: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa 'dril: rdor gshog nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam gdengs: dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas kyis brgyan: lcags phur gnod sbyin gdan la bzhugs: rdo rje rlung 'byin sku la 'khril: g.yas pa dgra s+t+wa g.yon dung khrag: yab yum sbyor ba'i byin rlabs las: phra men seng ge pha wang mgo: rdo rje me sgron phur pa 'debs: hūm̐: byang shar khams gsum rnam par rgyal: ser nag dkar dang ljang nag zhal: dang pos rdo rjes dung khrag dkrugs: bar pa gnyis na rdo rje zhags: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa 'dril: rdor gshog nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam gdengs: dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas kyis brgyan: lcags phur dbang ldan gdan la bzhugs: rdo rje gsod byed sku la 'khril: g.yas pa gri gug g.yon thod khrag: yab yum sbyor ba'i byin rlabs las: phra men dom dang sre mong mgo: dril bu lcags kyu phur pa 'debs: hūm̐: 'og tu stobs chen khro bo'i sku: dud kha nag dang ljang ba'i zhal: dang pos rdo rjes dung khrag dkrugs: bar pas tho ba zhags pa bsnams: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa 'dril: rdor gshog nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam gdengs: dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas kyis brgyan: lcags phur sa bdag gdan la bzhugs: rdo rje skul byed sku la 'khril: g.yas pa rtse dgu g.yon dung khrag: yab yum sbyor ba'i byin rlabs las: phra men dred dang byi ba'i mgo: rdo rje sog le phur pa 'debs:

de yi phyi rol gru chad bzhir: bh+yo: shar gyi dbang phyug ma bdun ni: smug nag g.yag mgo thod rlon thogs: tshangs pa dmar ser/ sbrul gdong pad+ma thogs: lha chen dkar/ gzig mgo dril bu thogs: brgya byin dkar/ khyung mgo in+t+ra gdeng: rtogs 'dod sngo/ byi la 'khor lo thogs: gzhon nu dmar/ pha wang mdung thung thogs: rdo rje khu byug nag/ lcags kyu 'dzin: lho yi dbang phyug ma bdun ni: bh+yo: rdo rje ser/ dom mgo thod khrag 'thung: bdud rtsi dmar/ chu srin bum pa 'dzin: zla ba dkar/ sdig mgo pun zla 'dzin: be con ljang nag/ khra mgo dbyug tho 'phyar: srin mo dmar nag/ wa gdong dung khrag 'thung: za ba ljang nag/ stag mgo ba su 'dren: ra mgo dmar ser zhags pa thogs: nub kyi dbang phyug ma bdun ni: bh+yo: dga' ba bya rgod dar dkar 'chang: stobs chen rta mgo gshol mda' 'dzin: gcig spyod shang shang spu gris gcod: 'dod dmar spyang ki mda' gzhu 'geng: nor srung pu shud dkar/ bum pa 'dzin: rlung lha sha mgo sngon mo/ bum pa thogs: bum sna sprel mgo sngo nag/ lcags sgrog thogs: byang gi dbang phyug ma bdun ni: bh+yo: gsod byed phag mgo

dmar mo/ ral gri thogs: me mo skyin mgo dmar/ gsal shing 'dzin: phag mgo dmar mo mche zhags 'dzin: rgan byed kaṃ ka dmar/ zhing chung 'dzin: sna chen rnga mong thod khrag 'thung: chu lha bya rog sngon mo/ sbrul zhags 'dzin: gsus chen spyang mgo ser nag/ dril bu thogs: g.yon pa thams cad phur pa 'debs: gzig sham zhing lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: zhing chen dgra bgegs steng na 'gying: de yi phyi rol bar khyams la: phur pa'i srung ma bcu gnyis ni: sho na mu kha zhes bya ba: lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu la: mi mo lcags kyi mgo can zhon: sri la mu kha zhes bya ba: gser gyi 'phar ba lce brgyad la: mi mo gser gyi mgo can zhon: sri la mu kha zhes bya ba: zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum la: mi mo zangs kyi mgo can zhon: sho na mu kha zhes bya ba: lcags kyi khyi mo ral pa can: mi mo lcags kyi mgo can zhon: g.yas rnams rdo rje thod phreng 'dren: g.yon rnams rin chen phur pa 'dril: dpal ldan nag mo re ma ti: mi lpags rlon pa sku la gsol: phyag na spu gri rnon po thogs: chibs su drel rta rkang gsum 'chib: dpal ldan lha mo re ma dzi: dmar nag btsos dmar la 'u gsol: khrag skam lcags kyu phyag na bsnams: chu glang sngon po chibs su 'chib: dpal ldan lha mo re ma dza: ser nag rma bya'i thul pa gsol: gser gyi zor ba phyag na bsnams: chibs su sha ba yu mo 'chib: dpal ldan nag mo re ma dzu: ljang nag chu dar sku la gsol: mthing nag khram bam phyag na bsnams: chibs su rnga mong sngo nag 'chib: rdo rje ya byin mthu mo che: mthing nag ber chen sku la gsol: phyag na bdud zhags lcags kyu bsnams: bdud rta nag po chibs su 'chib: rdo rje de byin rtsal mo che: sku mdog ser nag 'bar ba la: gser zhags skyer phur phyag na bsnams: chibs su gza' rta ser po 'chib: rdo rje bse byin 'phrul mo che: nag po ber smug sku la gsol:

btsan zhags seng ldeng phur pa bsnams: chibs su btsan rta dmar po 'chib: rdo rje phag byin mthu mo che: sngo nag ber nag sku la gsol: g.yu zhags mchog phur phyag na bsnams: chu rta sngon po chibs su 'chib: dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhi sgo bzhi ru: shar sgor stag gdong lcags kyu 'dzin: lhor sgor phag gdong zhags pa 'dzin: nub sgor seng gdong lcags sgrog ma: byang shar spyang gdong dril bu 'khrol: kun kyang gzig sham zhing lpags gsol: dgra bgegs steng du 'gying bar bskyed: phyi rol 'khor yug lcags ri la: bka' nyan dam can sde gsum dang: ma bdun sring bzhi la sogs dang: bka' sdod dam can ma lus bskyed: bzhi pa spyan drang ba la snyan gsan dang spyan drang ba gnyis las: dang po ni: hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams: srid pa rdo rjer sgrub mdzod cig: srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha: ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra sa man dza: gnyis pa spyan drang ba dngos ni: hūm̐: skye med chos dbyings pho brang nas: skye ba'i cho 'phrul skur ston pa: dpal ldan yab yum spyan 'dren gshegs: srid gsum gdug pa ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir: sras mchog khro bo'i tshogs rnams spyan 'dren gshegs: phyogs bcu dregs pa thams cad 'dul ba'i phyir: khro bcu yab yum za gsod spyan 'dren gshegs: dbang phyug mkha' 'gro srung ma dam can rnams: sngon gyi thugs dam brtser dgongs spyan 'dren gshegs: srid pa'i phur pa sgrub pa dang: dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir: ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol: ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor 'di la dbyer med dgongs: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: e h+ye hi bha ga wān: sa ma ya dza dza: lnga pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: snang srid yongs sgrol dkyil 'khor 'dir: dregs pa nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan: ye shes phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams: dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan:

drug pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: ho: srid gsum gdug pa 'dul ba dang: nga rgyal chen po brtan pa'i phyir: rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la: rtse gcig yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra ti dzaḥho: bdun pa dbang zhu ba ni: hūm̐: thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du: byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba: sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzad nas: dbang dang byin rlabs bdag stsol cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dkar dmar mthing gsum/ oṃ hūm̐ swā aṃ hā: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta gu ṇa karma sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rigs lngas dbu brgyan par bsam/ brgyad pa gnyis med bstim pa ni: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs: yon tan phrin las yongs rdzogs pa'i: bdag dang dbyer med thim gyur la: mdun gyi ye shes pa bdag bskyed la bstim/ rab tu dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: dgu pa phyi nang mchod pa ni: hūm̐: dpal chen yongs rdzogs lha tshogs la: phyi mchod lnga dang nang mchod lnga: phyi nang dbang po dgyes phyir 'bul: puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wid+ya: shab+da ma hā pañtsa pū tsa ho: bcu pa sman mchod bya ba ni: ho: rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag: rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman: rtsa ba 'bum phrag yangs pa'i bcud: ra sā yā na la sogs pa'i: rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos: ye shes lnga rdzogs bsgrubs pa'i rdzas: rgyud drug sems can kun sgrol ba'i: dug lnga sel ba'i sman gyi mchog: dpa' bo'i ro dang mnyam sbyar ba: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs la 'bul: bla med 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañtsa a mṛta khā hi: phyogs bcu dregs pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: bdud 'dul 'jigs byed khro bo yab yum bcur:

rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: zla gam dbang chen e yi gdan steng du: gdug pa'i tshogs sgrol sras mchog phur pa la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañtsa a mṛta la khā hi: gzhal yas chen po'i gru chad bzhi rnams la: dbang phyug chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: dkyil 'khor phyogs kyi bar khyams gzhal yas su: bka' yi skyong ma phur srung bcu gnyis la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: gzhal yas sgo ma bzhi yi zhal du yang: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: bse lcags dung sogs ging chen bzhi rnams la: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma'i zhal du yang: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐: khro bo chen po gshegs su gsol: khro bo chen po gshegs nas kyang: rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang: kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol: kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wā ka sid+dhi ā: tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: bcu gnyis pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dam rdzas rmad byung gtor chen po: chos nyid skye ba med klong nas: 'dod yon rnam lngas rab tu spras: dpal chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: sarba ba liṃ ta khā hi: nyon mongs rtsa ba 'khor ba'i khrag: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs bya'i phyir: dung chen snod du dmar chen bskyil: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du 'bul: badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: bcu gnyis pa sbyor sgrol mchod pa ni: gti mug sha chen phungs se phung: 'dod chags khrag chen me re re: zhe sdang rus gram nyi li li: dpal chen khro bo'i tshogs la 'bul: māṃ sa rak+ta keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: hūm̐: khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du: rdo rje tho bas brdungs byas nas:

lha yang rung ste bsgral bar bya'o: kha taṃ kha taṃ kha taṃ: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: badz+ra yak+ṣa kro ta khā hi: ha ha ha: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: bcu gsum pa bstod pas bsnyen pa ni: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus 'dus pa'i dpal: rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: skye med rnam dag shes rab gsal ba'i don: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum la phyag 'tshal bstod: sa bcu'i mnga' bdag zhing bcu tshar gcod pa: khro rgyal chen po bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod: pha rol phyin bcu'i rang bzhin shes rab dpal: khro mo chen mo bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod: nyon mongs nyi shu gnas su sgrol mdzad pa: khra thabs nyi shu'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs rje'i shugs kyis gnod gdug thams cad sgrol: sras mchog 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyi nang bar chad bsrung ba'i las la brtson: drag mo sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: rgyal ba'i spyan sngar dam bcas dbang mo che: phur skyong srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: bcu bzhi pa bsnyen cing dngos grub blang ba ni: gzhung gi dmigs pa gsal gdab cing: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: sarba bigha nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: ces dngos grub thob par bsam: dza hūm̐ ā: bdun 'bum nyi khri rtags dang sbyar: dngos grub blang ba ni: dpal chen lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: 'dir bzhugs bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams: smin grol gnyis kyi rgyud sbyangs te: bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug 'di bzung nas: zhi rgyas dbang drag yid bzhin gter: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: dngos grub da lta mi stsol na: rgyal ba thugs rje mi chung ngam: sgrub pa'i zhag grangs thems lags so: gtor tshogs 'byor pas bskangs lags so: thugs rje brtse bas rab dgongs nas: da lta nyid du dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐:

zhes dngos grub blang ngo: gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni: tshogs dang lhag ma bskul dang ni: bzlog gzhung gyer dang sgo dbye bya: chad mdo zor 'phang brtan skyong mnan: tshe 'gugs bsdu chog smon lam btab: bkra shis dang ni bcu gnyis so: dang por tshogs byang ni: swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs: bh+rūm̐ gyis snod gzhal yas khang du bskyed: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: nyes skyon thams cad bsregs sbyangs bkrus: oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'dod yon bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs: sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang: dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa la: ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te: bla ma yi dam lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: oṃ gu ru de wā ḍā ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: skabs 'dir skang gso'i rim pa gzhan yang bya: tshogs phud gsum las dang po 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen phur pa'i lha tshogs la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ga ṇa tsakra pū tsa khā hi: bar pa bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang: de yi 'khor du gtogs pa'i lha srin rnams: mi yi skyon mthong tsam na chad pa gcod: bdag cag ma rig sgo gsum bag med pas: 'dod 'khrul gti mug dbang gis nongs byas bshags: tshogs kyis mchod do tshangs dbang dngos grub stsol: sa ma ya ho: tha ma liṅga bcas te: gsal ba gsum dang ldan pas: liṅga la 'gugs 'dren byas: hūm̐ dza: dam tshig chen po'i dpal chen yab yum/ dus la bab: sprul pa chen po'i sras mchog/ dus la bab: phyag brnyan chen po'i khro bcu khra thabs/ dus la bab: shwa na mu kha'i mched bzhi/ dus la bab: bdag nyid chen mo'i

re ma ti mched bzhi/ dus la bab: sa bdag chen mo'i bse mo mched bzhi/ dus la bab: khyed kyi phrin las dus la bab: hūm̐: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i: rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni: gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs: bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams: khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis: yud tsam gcig gis 'dir khug la: mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang: lus ngag rdul du bshigs nas kyang: dngos grub bar du gcod pa'i bgegs: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams: zungs shig rgyob cig rnam par chings: gtogs shig grogs dang bral bar gyis: rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun: rdo rje tho bas brdungs byas nas: lha yang rung te bsgral bar bya: bcol pa'i phrin las myur du mdzod: ces bsgral te bstab pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen 'khor bcas zhal phyes shig: dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i lnga phung 'di: dpal chen yab yum zhal du bstab: sras mchog phur pa'i zhal du bstab: khro rgyal yab yum zhal du bstab: za gsod sgo ma'i zhal du bstab: mkha' 'gro ging tshogs zhal du bstab: rdul phran tsam yang med par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza ya kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes ling ro gtor mar 'bul lo: de rjes dmar sbreng: bdud rtsi bran: 'thor phud kyi rim pa yang 'di nas bya'o: de nas slob bus tshogs btegs la: gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos: sogs bya'o: bla mas: rin thang med la legs 'ongs chos: sogs kyis blang: de nas dpal chen lha tshogs su gsal bas tshogs la rol: tshogs kyi 'khor lo phul ba'i bsod nams kyis: mi zad gter la longs spyod cing: ye shes snang ba rang gsal nas: ka dag chen po'i sa thob shog: gnyis pa lhag ma bsdus la kha chus bran la 'di skad do: hūm̐: bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs: khyed kyi dam tshig dus la bab: sngon chad ji ltar dam bcas pa:

mngon spyod phrin las myur du mdzod: lhag ma'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bstan pa gnyan po bsrung du gsol: bud+dha ḍā ki nī: badz+ra ḍā ki nī: rat+na ḍā ki nī: pad+ma ḍā ki nī: karma ḍā ki nī: sarba ḍā ki nī: kha kha khā hi: ging ka ra pañtsa a mṛta ba ling+ta rak+ta khā hi: gsum pa thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: e yi dkyil 'khor gnas pa yi: bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma: sras mchog phur pa'i tshogs dang bcas: 'khor 'das dpal la dbang sgyur zhing: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: khro rgyal rnam rgyal yab yum dang: phra men stag dang bya rgod mgo: dri za'i tshogs la dbang sgyur zhing: thugs dam rgyud bskul= hūm̐: khro rgyal dbyug sngon yab yum dang: phra men g.yag dang bya rog mgo: me lha'i tshogs la dbang sgyur zhing: thugs dam rgyud bskul= hūm̐: khro rgyal gshin rje yab yum dang: phra men sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo: gshin rje'i tshogs la dbang sgyur zhing: thugs dam rgyud bskul= hūm̐: khro rgyal mi g.yo yab yum dang: phra men gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo: srin po'i tshogs la dbang sgyur zhing: thugs dam rgyud bskul= hūm̐: khro rgyal rta mgrin yab yum dang: phra men byi la pu shud mgo: chu lha'i tshogs la dbang sgyur zhing: thugs dam rgyud bskul= hūm̐: khro rgyal 'dod rgyal yab yum dang: phra men spyang mo khra yi mgo: rlung lha'i tshogs la dbang sgyur zhing: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: khro rgyal bdud rtsi yab yum dang: phra men seng ge pha wang mgo: gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang sgyur zhing: thugs dam rgyud bskul= hūm̐: khro rgyal khams gsum yab yum dang: phra men dom dang sre mong mgo: dbang ldan tshogs la dbang sgyur zhing: thugs dam rgyud bskul= hūm̐: khro chen hūm̐ kār yab yum dang: phra men phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo: nyi zla gza' skar dbang sgyur zhing:

thugs dam rgyud bskul= hūm̐: khro rgyal stobs chen yab yum dang: phra men dred dang byi ba'i mgo: sa bdag tshogs la dbang sgyur zhing: thugs dam rgyud bskul= lcags kyu ma yis dgra bgegs khug: zhags pa ma yis dgra bgegs chings: lcags sgrog ma yis dbang du sdus: dril bu ma yis gnas spor la: thugs dam rgyud bskul= dbang phyug chen po nyer brgyad rnams: myang 'das chos kyi skur bzhugs kyang: 'jig rten cha lugs cir yang ston: sprul pa yang sprul tshogs dang bcas: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: dpal gyi srung ma bcu gnyis dang: ma bdun sring bzhi ging laṅka: dam can srung ma'i tshogs bcas rnams: dam rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod:

ces so: rgyas par lhag mchod dang dgos bskul na yod do: 'di'i dbang bskur ba: 'di'i sbyin sreg: phrin las bzhi'i las gang yang bya zhing: bzlog gzhung byed na: liṅga bca' ba: snyan gsan: gzu dpang: bla srog 'gugs pa: lha dbye: mi 'chor byad du 'jug pa: chos bshad: bzlog gzhung byed pa: tshe lung khrus lung: thun gdab: bla srog phral ba: liṅga bsha' ba: zhal du bstab pa: gnas spar ba: lung bstan pa: smon lam dang: bsngo ba ste: bcu bdun gyis sgrol las mdor bstan du byed do: bzlog gzhung bsdus pa 'di ltar du bya'o: hūm̐: bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu che: sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: rigs kyi khro rgyal thams cad dbang sdus la: gzhan sprul khro bo'i dmag tshogs thams cad zlog: zhal gsum dug gsum sku gsung thugs su zlog: zhal g.yas dkar pos pho rgyud gnod byed zlog: zhal g.yon dmar pos mo rgyud gnod pa zlog: zhal dbus mthing khas gnyis 'dzin dgra bgegs zlog: nyon mongs dug gsum bar chad dbyings su zlog: dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa yis: srid gsum gdug pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad zlog: zhal gyi mche ba dkar po gtsigs pa yis: sha za 'byung po thams cad bsgral du gsol: thod skam rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dbu la rdzogs: khrag 'thung pho nya gnod byed thams cad zlog: spyan gsum sdang mig gyen thur g.yo ba yis: steng 'og bar gsum gdon bgegs thams cad zlog: phyag g.yas dang po rdo rje rtse dgu yis: sa dgu'i rtog tshogs bar chad thams cad zlog: gnyis pa rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams pa yis: nyon mongs dug lnga'i bar chad thams cad zlog: g.yon gyi dang po'i ye shes me dpung gis: mtshan 'dzin 'khor ba'i dgra bgegs bsregs shing zlog: tha ma gnyis na ri rab phur pa yis: sa lam bar chod dgra bgegs bzlog cing sgrol: zhing chen g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yogs byas pa yis: phrag dog las byung dgra bgegs thams cad zlog:

glang chen ko rlon gti mug dgra bgegs zlog: thod pa'i phreng bas sems byung rtog tshogs zlog: phyag zhabs sbrul gyi chun pos brgyan pa yis: 'og phyogs klu yi gdon rnams thams cad zlog: thod pa skam pos dbu rgyan byas pa yis: steng phyogs lha yi gdon rnams thams cad zlog: stag gi pags pas sham thabs byas pa yis: nga rgyal dregs pa'i gdon tshogs thams cad zlog: thal chen tshom bu zhag gi zo ris kyis: 'khor ba'i bcud gsol skye shi'i sdug bsngal zlog: zhabs gnyis thabs dang shes rab brkyang bskum gyis: nyon mongs bdud bzhi ma lus thams cad zlog: gnyis med yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mas: mo rgyud gdon bgegs thams cad zlog tu gsol: sprul pa'i sras mchog nyi shu rtsa gcig gis: lus ngag yid gsum bar chad thams cad zlog: khro chen hūm̐ chen yab yum sprul pa yis: tshangs pa nyi zla'i gdon tshogs dgra la zlog: khro chen rnam rgyal yab yum sprul pa yis: shar phyogs dri za'i gdon tshogs dgra la zlog: khro chen dbyug sngon yab yum sprul pa yis: shar lho me lha'i gdon tshogs dgra= khro chen gshin rje yab yum sprul pa yis: lho phyogs gshin rje'i gdon tshogs dgra= khro chen mi g.yo yab yum sprul pa yis: lho nub srin po'i gdon tshogs dgra= khro chen rta mgrin yab yum sprul pa yis: nub phyogs klu dbang gdon tshogs dgra= khro chen 'dod rgyal yab yum sprul pa yis: nub byang rlung lha'i gdon tshogs dgra= khro chen bdud rtsi yab yum sprul pa yis: byang phyogs gnod sbyin gdon tshogs dgra= khro chen khams gsum yab yum sprul pa yis: byang shar dbang ldan gdon tshogs dgra= khro chen stobs chen yab yum sprul pa yis: 'og phyogs sa bdag gdon tshogs dgra= dbang phyug chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis: lha chen nyer brgyad gdug rtsub dgra= brtan ma skyong ma phur srung bcu gnyis kyis:

nad kha rims kha thams cad dgra la= ye shes sgo ma bzhi yi lha tshogs kyis: phyag rgya bzhi yis dgra bgegs sgrol zhing zlog: yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa zlog: mas kyi sri ru langs pa zlog: nye ba'i byol po thams cad= ma mo'i khrag zor 'phen pa= bdud kyi sprul pa'i 'grim chags= pha tshan nang gi rgyab 'dre= gshin rje'i 'khor lo bskor ba= bdud kyis khram la 'debs pa= btsan gyi rgyan kha thams cad= sa bdag klu yis gdug byed= rgyal po'i smyo 'dre thams cad= gza' yis king kang 'phen pa= mu stegs ngan sngags dmod mo= the'u brang sris la rku ba= nad kha rims kha slar phyir zlog: phur pa'i dbal kha thams cad= chos pa'i chos zor 'phen pa= bon po'i bon zor 'phen pa= sum pa'i glang zor 'phen pa= mi nyag pa yi bo lo= lo keg zla keg zhag keg= mo ngan rmi ltas ngan pa= pho brgyas mda' ltar gsor ba= mo brgyas dug g.yos bh+yo zhing zlog: dgra la bh+yo zhing bsgral du gsol: mi nag skye bo'i ya ga= bran khol ngan pa'i dmod mchu= dgra la bh+yo zhing bsgral du gsol: bgegs la bh+yo las rdul du rlogs: bzhi pa dkyil 'khor dbye ba ni: dza: dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar sgo na: sgo ma chen mo stag gdong ma: thugs rje thabs kyi lde'u mig dang: rdo rje lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yis: shar phyogs dung sgo dkar po phyes: gtor ma zor gyi lam phyes shig: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor chen po'i lho sgo na: sgo ma chen mo phag gdong ma: thugs rje thabs kyi lde'u mig dang: rdo rje zhags pa'i phyag rgya yis: lho phyogs gser sgo ser po phyes: gtor ma zor gyi lam phyes shig: baṃ: dkyil 'khor chen po'i nub sgo na: sgo ma chen mo seng gdong ma: thugs rje thabs kyi lde'u mig dang: rdo rje lcags sgrog phyag rgya yis: nub sgo zangs sgo dmar po phyes: gtor ma zor gyi lam phyes shig: ho: dkyil 'khor chen po'i byang sgo na: sgo ma chen mo spyang gdong ma:

thugs rje thabs kyi lde'u mig dang: rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yis: byang sgo g.yu sgo sngon po phyes: gtor ma zor gyi lam phyes shig: lnga pa chad mdo bya ba ni: gtor ma sgo mtshams su btegs la gser skyems gtor zhing 'di skad do: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: 'og min gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yis: rigs kyi khro rgyal thams cad dbang bsdus nas: so so'i sku gsung thugs su bstan nas kyang: ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin du: mchod gtor bzhes la bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og bar gyi bskal pa dbus ma la: mon kha sna ring seng ge rdzong gsum du: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: slob ma jo mo mkhar chen mtsho rgyal gyis: rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: phur srung bcu gnyis ging dang dam can gyis: so so'i sku gsung thugs su bstan nas kyang: ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin du: mchod gtor bzhes la bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: de 'og dus kyi bskal pa'i tha ma la: rnga yab gling phran zang mdog dpal ri'i rtser: slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod phreng dang: rig 'dzin sngags 'chang pad+ma gling pa yis: yang gsang bla med dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: bka' yi srung ma dam can rgya mtsho yis: so so'i sku gsung thugs su bstan nas kyang: ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin du: mchod gtor bzhes la bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma phyir khyer: zor 'phang ba ni: hūm̐: snying rje'i gtor zor gnyan po 'di: shar gyi phyogs su 'phang snyam pas: dri za'i tshogs rnams sku zur cig: zor 'di gnod byed dgra bgegs 'phen: snying rje'i gtor zor gnyan po 'di: lho yi phyogs su 'phang snyam pas: gshin rje'i tshogs rnams sku zur cig: zor 'di gnod byed dgra bgegs 'phen: snying rje'i gtor zor gnyan po 'di:

nub kyi phyogs su 'phang snyam pas: chu lha'i tshogs rnams sku zur cig: zor 'di gnod byed dgra bgegs 'phen: snying rje'i gtor zor gnyan po 'di: byang gi phyogs su 'phang snyam pas: gnod sbyin tshogs rnams sku zur cig: zor 'di gnod byed dgra bgegs 'phen: snying rje'i gtor zor gnyan po 'di: shar lho'i phyogs su 'phang snyam pas: me lha'i tshogs rnams sku zur cig: zor 'di gnod byed dgra bgegs 'phen: snying rje'i gtor zor gnyan po 'di: lho nub mtshams su 'phang snyam pas: srin po'i tshogs rnams sku zur cig: zor 'di gnod byed dgra bgegs 'phen: snying rje'i gtor zor gnyan po 'di: nub byang mtshams su 'phang snyam pas: rlung lha'i tshogs rnams sku zur cig: zor 'di gnod byed dgra bgegs 'phen: snying rje'i gtor zor gnyan po 'di: byang shar mtshams su 'phang snyam pas: dbang ldan tshogs rnams sku zur cig: zor 'di gnod byed dgra bgegs 'phen: snying rje'i gtor zor gnyan po 'di: steng gi phyogs su 'phang snyam pas: tshangs pa nyi zla sku zur cig: zor 'di gnod byed dgra bgegs 'phen: snying rje'i gtor zor gnyan po 'di: 'og gi phyogs su 'phang snyam pas: sa bdag tshogs rnams sku zur cig: zor 'di gnod byed dgra bgegs 'phen: sangs rgyas bstan la gnod pa dang: skye bo yongs la 'tshe ba dang: mdor na zhing bcur gyur pa yi: sdang dgra gnod byed thams cad dang: bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor gyi: tshe srog bar du gcod pa yi: dgra bgegs steng du gtor zor rgyob: thum ri li li rbad rbad bh+yo bh+yo: drag sngags rnams kyis dpung bskyed do: bdun pa bshal chus brtan ma bskyang ba ni: bdag dpal chen du gsal la 'di skad do: bh+yo: brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas: khyed cag sngon gyi yal gam can: slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng dang: slob ma mkhar chen mtsho rgyal gyis: mon kha sna ring rdzong gsum du:

zhing chen bsgral ba'i gdan steng du: rnal 'byor gral la bzhag nas ni: thar pa thob pa'i mtshan yang btags: sgrub pa po la phan gdags phyir: bran gyi tshul du khas blangs nas: dam la ma 'da' da tshur byon: bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: ma ma: la la: ta ta: te te: pañtsa bha ling ta khā hi: brgyad pa gtor mnan bya ba ni: gtor gzhong ri rab tu gsal pa'i 'og tu dam sri mnan par bsam ste: yi dam dpal chen stangs stabs kyis mnan par bya ste: lu gu rgyud du sbrel la 'di skad do: ho: dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i lnga phung la: dpal chen lha tshogs bro brdungs pas: dgra bgegs phung khams rdul du rlog: dgra ni thal bar rlog pa'i bro: bgegs ni phye mar 'thag pa'i bro: oṃ laṃ: āḥlaṃ: hūm̐ laṃ: s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: ya ma dam sri nā ga rā tsa dza nan: zhes mnan no: dgu pa tshe 'gugs bya ba: ࿌ bcu pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes brjod pas snang srid 'od du zhu: gzhal yas khang la thim: gzhal yas lha tshogs lha rnams 'khor nas rim gyis gtso bor bsdu: gtso bo ye shes sems dpa' la bsdu: ye shes sems dpa' thugs srog hūm̐ la: hūm̐ gyen rdzogs kyi thig ler yal te: rtag mtha' bsal lo: rdul tshon rnams rdo rjes mtha' nas dbus su bsdu'o: yig brgyas kha bskang: bcu gcig pa smon lam ni: de ltar gsang sngags spyod pa mchog: rmad byung spyad pa'i mthu byin gyis: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang: phrin las mi zad rgyan 'khor la: spyod cing skal pa mnyam gyur cig: bcu gnyis pa bkra shis bya ba ni: rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las mchog: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi: sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las kyis: dug gsum 'joms pa'i bkra shis shog: phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs kun sgrol ba: khro bo bcu yi bkra shis shog: dge bcu yar 'phel mi dge gcod:

khro mo bcu yi bkra shis shog: phrin las rnam bzhi kun sgrub cing: ma sring brtse gdung bkra shis pa: mkha' 'gro dam can bkra shis shog: mi 'dzad gter la mnga' brnyes shing: 'dzad med nor gyi bkra shis pa: don grub mchog gi bkra shis shog: phur pa yang gsang gi las byang khrigs chog: bdag pad+ma gling pas khrigs su bsgrigs pa'o: maṅga laṃ/// /
